description: Get one web page as clean, LLM-ready markdown (or text, HTML, JSON) in a single call; rendering and tier escalation are handled for you. Use when you have one URL and want its content; for an image use alterlab_screenshot, for 2-20 URLs alterlab_batch_scrape, for a whole site alterlab_crawl. Cost: from $0.0002 per page, up to $0.02 on the hardest pages; it starts at the cheapest tier that works and cache hits cost half. A 403/429, challenge page or empty JavaScript shell is retried on higher tiers automatically. Supports GET and POST via method, extraction via extraction_schema or extraction_prompt, cost caps via cost_controls, and browser actions via actions plus screenshot and generate_pdf; action_results has one entry per action with index, type, success, error, result (evaluate) and screenshot_url (screenshot actions). When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns. A failure may carry next_action install_hands: reason, what Hands unlocks, install link, resume ref. Max 3 parallel calls/domain; use max_credits.

actions.description: Browser actions run in order after the page loads, before content extraction and any screenshot or PDF capture. Requires a rendered page; render_js defaults to true when actions are given. Selectors are CSS, or XPath when prefixed with '//' or 'xpath='. Failed actions are skipped and the sequence continues. The response includes action_results, one entry per action with index, type, success, error, result (evaluate, extract, select) and screenshot_url (screenshot actions).

cost_controls.description: Cap spending, pin a tier, or trade off cost vs speed.

max_tier.description: Advanced; leave unset unless you know the target works at this tier. A cap below the tier a domain needs fails the request ("this domain requires at least tier N, but your request is capped at tier M") and is not raised for you. Use max_credits to bound spend instead.

estimate_first.description: Run a free cost estimate before scraping. Default: false.

extraction_prompt.description: Natural language extraction instruction. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

formats.description: Output formats. 'markdown' is best for LLM consumption. 'structured_data' returns only the page's JSON-LD (@graph and ItemList listings flattened into product/job/listing entities with position), Open Graph, Twitter card, microdata and embedded app state (__NEXT_DATA__, Apollo), at the normal tier price. Default: ["markdown"].

generate_pdf.description: Generate a PDF of the rendered page after any actions (adds a small fee, uses a rendered page). The response includes pdf_url.

include_raw_html.description: Return the fetched pre-render origin HTML as top-level raw_html. formats ["html"] returns post-render cleaned HTML in content.html. Default: false.

method.description: HTTP method. POST is for GraphQL, forms and REST APIs. Default: GET.

mode.description: Scraping mode: auto (recommended), html, js (headless browser), pdf, or ocr Default: auto.

render_js.description: Render JavaScript with a headless browser. 'auto' renders only when needed. Default: false.

screenshot.description: Capture a full-page screenshot after any actions (adds a small fee, uses a rendered page). The response includes screenshot_url.

tag.description: Optional spend-attribution tag (lowercase letters, digits, _ . -; max 64 chars; up to 20 active tags per organization). Usage and spend are reported per tag, and a tag with a max_spend_usd budget stops accepting new work with 402 tag_budget_exhausted once the cap is reached.

use_proxy.description: Route through a premium proxy. Default: false.
